outDir.description: Where the artifacts go, relative to the repository root.

ref.description: The ref whose first-parent history is walked. Null detects origin/HEAD, then origin/main, then origin/master, then HEAD.

exclude.description: Globs to skip, added to the default excludes.

test.description: Globs that mark a test file. Replaces the defaults.

workspaces.description: Globs naming workspace directories, such as packages/*. Null makes each directory with a package.json a workspace.

events.description: Labelled markers drawn on the charts.

coverage.description: Coverage commands for the CRAP score. Empty turns CRAP off.

cwd.description: Directory to run in, relative to the repository root.

command.description: Shell command that writes an lcov report.

lcov.description: The lcov file the command writes, relative to cwd.
